description: This source file implements classes and functions for transforming and handling requests and responses between an OpenAI-like chat API and Triton's /generate and /infer endpoints within a machine learning project. It defines configuration classes, request and response transformers, and an iterator for streaming responses, all tailored to interface with Triton models via specific API endpoints.

classes.name: TritonConfig
classes.description: Base class managing common configuration and response transformation logic for Triton API endpoints, routing between /generate and /infer.

classes.name: TritonGenerateConfig
classes.description: Handles request and response transformations specific to Triton's /generate endpoint, integrating with prompt factory and handling stream responses.

classes.name: TritonInferConfig
classes.description: Handles request and response transformations specific to Triton's /infer endpoint, mainly for custom models with input/output formatting.

classes.name: TritonResponseIterator
classes.description: An iterator class for parsing streaming chunks from Triton responses, yielding uniform streaming chunks for further processing.

methods.description: Maps openai parameters into optional parameters for Triton API calls.
